item.title: ‘Chosen people’: Controversial US Border Patrol officer said to mock Jewish prosecutor
item.description: Gregory Bovino complained that US Attorney in Minnesota Daniel Rosen — an Orthodox Jew — was difficult to reach during Shabbat, New York Times reports The post ‘Chosen people’: Controversial US Border Patrol officer said to mock Jewish prosecutor appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Prominent UK activist arrested at London protest for ‘Globalize the intifada’ sign
item.description: Peter Tatchell, a veteran human rights campaigner and LGBTQ advocate, brands arrest as 'attack on free speech'; police say two more arrested for Palestine Action support The post Prominent UK activist arrested at London protest for ‘Globalize the intifada’ sign appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: US ambassador to Israel says Trump not making ’empty threats’ toward Iran
item.description: Mike Huckabee tells Israeli TV that decision on US strike on Iran yet to be made; says embassy surprised by cancellation of flights to Israel; vows Turkey won't receive F-35s The post US ambassador to Israel says Trump not making ’empty threats’ toward Iran appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Despite threats from Trump, parliamentary majority in Iraq backs Maliki as PM
item.description: Coordination Framework, country's main Shiite alliance, says decision on Iraq's leader should be 'free from foreign interference' after US president vowed to cut support if Maliki returns The post Despite threats from Trump, parliamentary majority in Iraq backs Maliki as PM appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Moody’s boosts Israel’s credit outlook to stable as ceasefires in Gaza, Lebanon hold
item.description: While the rating agency revised its outlook from negative to stable, it kept Israel's Baa1 credit rating in place, warning of fragile 'geopolitical and security environments' The post Moody’s boosts Israel’s credit outlook to stable as ceasefires in Gaza, Lebanon hold appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Resurfaced photo shows detained Gaza hospital director wearing Hamas uniform
item.description: Hussam Abu Safiya, the director of the Kamal Adwan Hospital, has been in Israeli custody since December 2024, although the IDF has not accused him of any specific acts of terror The post Resurfaced photo shows detained Gaza hospital director wearing Hamas uniform appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Rafah crossing set to open today for pedestrian traffic in both directions
item.description: Right-wing agitator blocks car of former PM Ehud Barak for the second time in days * Iran declares European militaries as 'terrorist groups' after EU lists IRGC as one The post Rafah crossing set to open today for pedestrian traffic in both directions appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Iran, US confirm progress being made toward negotiations as Trump’s threat still lingers
item.description: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian says broader conflict will hurt both countries, not in anyone's interest; Trump warns if dialogue fails, there's 'a big fleet heading out there' The post Iran, US confirm progress being made toward negotiations as Trump’s threat still lingers appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Arab, Jewish protesters turn out in record numbers for Tel Aviv anti-crime protest
item.description: Head of leading Arab org gives rare Hebrew speech in bid to bring issue of violence, perceived neglect to Jewish audience; Odeh: protest may be 'turning point' for Jewish-Arab ties The post Arab, Jewish protesters turn out in record numbers for Tel Aviv anti-crime protest appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Last US-Russia nuclear weapons pact set to end, with Trump mum on extension
item.description: New START treaty expires this week, ending decades of agreements between two top nuclear powers; White House says president wants China to join next pact, but nothing in the works The post Last US-Russia nuclear weapons pact set to end, with Trump mum on extension appeared first on The Times of Israel.
